content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison-plot script for the FUNWAVE-TVD spherical conical island benchmark, case C. Identical to the case_A/B versions except: measured file C.txt (L2), lag time_lag_case_A=22.63 (L8, variable name kept from case A), axis ax=[25 41 -0.06 0.1] (L34). Model stations sta_0001/0002/0008/0013 mapped to gauges 6/9/16/22 (L3-6); model time /scaleT(=10) + lag, elevation /scaleS(=100) (L9-10, L18-28); 4-panel measured-vs-model subplot loop (L36-49) with xlabel 'x (m)' on the last panel.
entities: script variables: data1 @L2, data6 @L3, data9 @L4, data16 @L5, data22 @L6, time_lag_case_A @L8, scaleT @L9, scaleS @L10, t @L12, measure @L13-16, tmodel/model @L18-28, gauge @L30-33, ax @L34, i @L37

equations.ref: time rescale (0.1-s units) and lag (same L21, L24, L27)
elevation cm to m (same L22, L25, L28)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2-6; clf @L36; subplot @L38; plot @L39, @L41; hold on @L40; title @L42; ylabel @L43; grid @L44; axis @L45; xlabel @L47
unresolved: Lag variable named time_lag_case_A (L8) holds 22.63 -- same value as the Cartesian case C script; correctness for the spherical case C run not determinable here.
scaleT=10/scaleS=100 imply 0.1-s time units and cm elevations in this spherical run's station files.
xlabel 'x (m)' (L47) on a time axis -- same label error as the sibling scripts.
